bagPolicy.summary: Each guest may bring one clear bag no larger than 12 by 12 by 6 inches or one small clutch no larger than 4.5 by 6.5 inches. Medical, family, and childcare bags are permitted after inspection.
bagPolicy.note: Diaper and medical bags may exceed the size limit but will be searched.

parking.note: Iowa Events Center parking is available from entrances on 3rd Street and 5th Avenue. The facility is cashless; rates and advance-reservation availability can change by event.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Casey's Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Permanent and portable concession stands operate on the main and upper concourses. Casey's Center is cashless, with the limited cash-to-gift-card option described in the official venue policies.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Casey's Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Casey's Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For other events that fall on a Saturday, Sunday, or Monday, the box office will open at 12pm (or 2 hours before the event starts for morning shows). The Casey's Center Ticket Office located in the Southwest corner of Casey's Center.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For most events, doors open 60 minutes prior to the start time of the event.
